concepts.name: Quirk
concepts.definition: The brand-level operating system and shared conceptual machinery of Quirk Systems.

concepts.name: Quirk Core
concepts.definition: Canonical source of identity, ontology, rules, schemas, permissions, prompts, memory and shared logic.

concepts.name: Ontology
concepts.definition: Defines what kinds of things exist in Quirk and their essential distinctions.

concepts.name: Taxonomy
concepts.definition: Classifies Quirk entities into named hierarchical or faceted categories.

concepts.name: Topology
concepts.definition: Describes how Quirk entities are connected regardless of their classification hierarchy.

concepts.name: Grammar
concepts.definition: Defines legal combinations, constructions and transformations among Quirk entities.

concepts.name: Constraint
concepts.definition: A required, prohibited or bounded condition applied to Quirk behavior or structure.

concepts.name: Semantics
concepts.definition: Defines the precise meaning and interpretation of Quirk terms and structures.

concepts.name: Provenance
concepts.definition: Records where an assertion, concept or decision came from and how authority was established.

concepts.name: Projection
concepts.definition: A rendered or operational view of canonical Quirk knowledge for a specific surface.

concepts.name: Asset
concepts.definition: A preserved reusable Quirk output with identity, state and lineage.

concepts.name: Capability
concepts.definition: An ability Quirk can reliably perform or expose.

concepts.name: Skill
concepts.definition: A bounded reusable implementation of a capability.

concepts.name: Script
concepts.definition: An executable or procedural sequence that performs defined work.

concepts.name: Control
concepts.definition: A mechanism that changes, constrains or selects runtime behavior.

concepts.name: Command
concepts.definition: An explicit invocation that requests a Quirk action.

concepts.name: Character
concepts.definition: A named operating persona with defined behavior, voice, permissions or specialties.

concepts.name: Quirk Move
concepts.definition: An atomic purposeful operation that changes, interprets, structures or advances something.

concepts.name: Transform
concepts.definition: The move family that changes form, representation, state or properties while preserving relevant lineage.

concepts.name: Mutate
concepts.definition: A transformation that changes selected properties while preserving enough identity for lineage to remain meaningful.

concepts.name: Quirk Action Router
concepts.definition: Routes work into operational lanes and depths without replacing the underlying capability ontology.

concepts.name: Quirk Capability Registry
concepts.definition: Canonical inventory of Quirk capabilities and their operational metadata.

concepts.name: Preference Graph
concepts.definition: Canonical preference graph and scoring substrate for personalization decisions.

concepts.name: Quirk Feed
concepts.definition: Aggregation surface for Quirk data feed entries and derived knowledge streams.

concepts.name: Realm
concepts.definition: A live contextual operating environment; not a synonym for ontology, taxonomy or organization.

concepts.name: Ritual
concepts.definition: A structured repeatable sequence of Quirk operations.
